verdicts.reason: A keeps a clean centred stack (logo, can, headline, CTA, legal anchored at the bottom). However, both circles were shrunk and the top-right one now floats inside the canvas instead of bleeding off the edge, which weakens the original feel. There is also a dead gap between the CTA and the legal line, and the legal text clips the edge of the bottom-left circle. B keeps the large bleeding circles, which is closer to the original, but the can now sits on the top-right circle and the legal text sits on the bottom-left circle. B's legal line also floats about 100px above the bottom, and the logo is pushed down under empty space. That makes B's layout look less deliberate.
